howTo.title: How to Create an Invoice Online in 3 Steps
howTo.subtitle: Create professional client invoices with no account signups or subscriptions.

steps.title: Enter Your Business and Client Details
steps.description: Add your business name, company logo, contact information, and client billing address.
steps.tip: Upload your brand logo to automatically scale and center it on your invoice letterhead.

steps.title: Add Line Items, Discounts, and Taxes
steps.description: Itemize your products or services. Totals, tax rates, and discounts calculate automatically with exact two-decimal precision.
steps.tip: Set custom payment terms like Net 15, Net 30, or Due upon Receipt with one click.

steps.title: Download Clean PDF or Print
steps.description: Select from four clean visual templates and export a watermark-free A4 or US Letter PDF instantly.
steps.tip: Click 'Export PNG' to generate a high-resolution image ready to send via email or messaging apps.

whatItMustContain.title: What an Official Invoice Must Contain
whatItMustContain.subtitle: Essential fields required for commercial validity, clean bookkeeping, and tax compliance.
whatItMustContain.disclaimer: General information, not legal or tax advice. Check your local rules.

items.title: Business and Sender Identity
items.description: Your registered business name or trading name, physical address, email, phone number, and tax registration ID [Verify with official source: commercial company invoicing statutes].

items.title: Client Invoicing Information
items.description: Full name or corporate entity name of the client, accounts payable email, and physical billing address.

items.title: Unique Invoice Number and Date
items.description: A sequential invoice identifier (for example, INV-001) and issue date for accounting and tax audit records.

items.title: Itemized Breakdown of Services
items.description: Clear descriptions of deliverables, quantities, hourly rates or unit prices, and line subtotals.

items.title: Tax Rates and Applicable Discounts
items.description: Separately itemized taxes (such as VAT, GST, or Sales Tax) and any promotional discounts or credits.

items.title: Payment Terms and Remittance Details
items.description: An explicit due date, bank wire or ACH account numbers, PayPal, Stripe, or local transfer details.

faq.title: Invoice Generator FAQs
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about creating, saving, and downloading invoices.

items.question: Is Online Invoice Creator really 100% free with no watermarks?
items.answer: Yes. You can create, print, and download unlimited invoices and receipts in PDF or PNG format with zero watermarks and no mandatory signup.

items.question: Is my client and financial data kept private?
items.answer: Yes. Our tool is 100% serverless and local-first. All calculations, logo uploads, and PDF rendering execute strictly within your browser. Nothing is uploaded to any remote server or database.

items.question: Can I save my business details for future invoices?
items.answer: Yes. Your business info, currency, and logo are saved securely in your browser's local storage so you do not need to re-enter them on your next visit.

items.question: What happens if a client has already paid me?
items.answer: If payment has already cleared, switch to our Free Online Receipt Generator to issue an official proof of payment or payment receipt.
